ideas.pitch: A localized digital twin model targeting Type 2 Diabetes prevalent in India, simulating real-time glucose response based on regional meal intake and simulated wearable continuous glucose monitor (CGM) streams.
ideas.title: GlucoTwin: Type 2 Diabetes Postprandial Glucose Surge Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly hits the core prompt requirement to select a specific, highly prevalent chronic condition in India and build a focused proof-of-concept digital twin.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered digital twin prototype that ingests simulated continuous blood pressure and heart rate variability metrics to forecast acute hypertensive episodes 4 hours before onset.
ideas.title: CardioTwin-Risk: Hypertension and Stroke Early Warning Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on proactive digital health prevention—shifting from reactive care to proactive modeling, which matches the overarching summit philosophy.

ideas.pitch: A localized digital twin combining regional particulate matter (PM2.5) data streams with simulated pulmonary function test histories to predict individual daily asthma exacerbation risks.
ideas.title: AeroTwin: Urban Asthma and COPD Respiratory Trigger Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-world environmental health challenges prevalent in Indian metropolitan areas, scoring high on local relevance and practical preventive utility.

ideas.pitch: A specialized simulation model replicating metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (NASH) trajectories using patient EHR data, diet logs, and synthetic liver enzyme fluctuations.
ideas.title: NASH-Twin: Metabolic Liver Disease Progression Model
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles a complex, emerging lifestyle disease epidemic in India with a clear, niche proof-of-concept scope suitable for a 48-hour build.

ideas.pitch: A predictive digital twin module estimating eGFR decline rates in diabetic nephropathy patients using longitudinal creatinine and blood pressure time-series records.
ideas.title: NephroTwin: Chronic Kidney Disease Deterioration Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clinical explainability and addresses a massive chronic disease burden in India, fitting the proactive medicine mandate of the Digital Twin Challenge.
